svg.aria-label: Deployment: docker compose runs nginx, the Spring Boot API and PostgreSQL; local development uses Vite and Testcontainers instead
svg.title: Deployment: docker compose runs nginx, the Spring Boot API and PostgreSQL; local development uses Vite and Testcontainers instead
svg.text: Left: what docker compose up --build starts. Right: the same pieces during local development.
docker compose · one network, services find each other by name
Images are built in two stages (multi-stage Dockerfiles):
frontend: node:24-slim → npm ci, npm run build → copy dist/ into nginx
backend: temurin:25-jdk → gradlew bootJar → copy app.jar into the JRE image
Local development (no Docker for the app)
hot reload of the React code
started and stopped with the app
a fresh, empty database each run
Why a proxy in both cases: the browser always calls /api on the same origin it loaded the page from,
so the backend needs no CORS configuration and the same frontend build works in both setups.
